overview.heading: What is on the Wetherspoons dessert menu?
overview.body:
The Wetherspoons dessert menu brings together chocolate desserts, traditional puddings, fruit crumbles and ice cream-based choices. [Warm Chocolate Fudge Cake](/desserts/chocolate-fudge-cake) is a dense, layered cake served warm, while [Sticky Toffee Pudding](/desserts/sticky-toffee-pudding) combines a dark sponge with a sweet, buttery toffee sauce. Mini Warm Chocolate Brownie offers another warm chocolate option, but in a smaller format. These are useful distinctions if you know the flavour you want but have not decided how substantial a dessert should be.

Fruit-led alternatives include [Bramley Apple Crumble](/desserts/bramley-apple-crumble) and British Bramley Apple & Blackberry Crumble. Fresh Fruit with Ice Cream pairs chopped seasonal fruit with vanilla ice cream, while Millionaires Dessert layers vanilla ice cream with shortbread pieces. Vegan Chocolate Tart provides a plant-based chocolate option with a smooth filling and chocolate pastry case.

overview.heading: Which Wetherspoons desserts are small or substantial?
overview.body:
Mini Warm Chocolate Brownie is the clearest smaller-format choice, while Warm Chocolate Fudge Cake is described as a large slice. The brownie has a dense, fudgy texture and Belgian chocolate sauce, making it a useful option when you want chocolate without committing to the larger cake. No portion weights are supplied, so the words mini and large are more useful here than an assumed serving size or calorie comparison.

Millionaires Dessert takes a different approach, presenting layers of vanilla ice cream and crumbly shortbread in a tall glass. Sticky Toffee Pudding offers sponge and sauce rather than a layered cake or sundae. Choose between these formats according to appetite and texture: a smaller brownie, a substantial cake slice, a sauced pudding or an ice cream dessert.

bestChoices.title: Best for a smaller appetite
bestChoices.text: Mini Warm Chocolate Brownie suits someone who wants a smaller sweet finish. Its dense, fudgy texture and Belgian chocolate sauce keep the focus on chocolate without choosing the large slice offered by Warm Chocolate Fudge Cake.

bestChoices.title: Best for a substantial chocolate dessert
bestChoices.text: Warm Chocolate Fudge Cake is the strongest fit for a bigger appetite. The large, layered slice is described as dense and moist, with fudge icing that begins to melt when served warm.

bestChoices.title: Best for a vegan choice
bestChoices.text: Vegan Chocolate Tart is the explicitly vegan option in this selection. Its smooth dark chocolate filling and crumbly chocolate pastry case offer a different texture from the warm cake and brownie choices.

bestChoices.title: Best for a traditional pudding
bestChoices.text: Sticky Toffee Pudding suits diners looking for a traditional British sponge pudding rather than cake, crumble or an ice cream dessert. Its dark sponge and sweet, buttery toffee sauce are the defining features.

bestChoices.title: Best for a fruit-led dessert
bestChoices.text: Fresh Fruit with Ice Cream pairs chopped seasonal fruit with vanilla ice cream. Choose it when you want fruit rather than sponge or pastry, and ask which fruits are included if that affects your decision.

bestChoices.title: Best for crumble with berries
bestChoices.text: British Bramley Apple & Blackberry Crumble adds sweet blackberries to tart Bramley apples beneath a buttery crumble topping. It suits someone who likes the apple crumble format but wants berries in the filling.
